sections.title: The letter qu
paragraphs: The letter name is (qu) /ky/. Its main sound is heard in the word (cinq) /sɛ̃k/, which means five. This letter has only one sound when it stands alone. You almost always see it written before another letter.

sections.title: Making the sound
paragraphs: Press the back of your tongue against the soft roof of your mouth. Stop the air for a moment. Then let the air burst out. Keep your vocal cords still. Touch your throat with your fingers to feel that it does not shake.

sections.title: Reading the letter
paragraphs: When the letter stands alone at the end of a word, it sounds like /k/. You hear this sound at the end of (coq) /kɔk/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not blow a puff of air when you release the stop. It is not like the first sound in key. Cut the air sharply without an extra breath.
